thanks.aboutDesc: "Dialect Pronunciation Atlas" is an online tool for analyzing Middle Chinese categories, comparing dialects, and exploring geolinguistic patterns. It presents the historical layering of initials and finals and the merger and split patterns of phonemes across dialect locations in a clear, interactive form.
thanks.feature1: Feature 1: Middle Chinese (organize readings by Middle Chinese categories). Users can combine categories such as rhyme group, rime, division, openness, tone, initial class, initial group, initial, voicing, place of articulation, and manner of articulation. The site analyzes initials, finals, and tones from the selected combination and presents the results in tables and maps.
thanks.feature2: Feature 2: Readings (trace dialect readings back to their Middle Chinese sources). Users enter dialect readings, and the site identifies the Middle Chinese categories represented by the matching characters, with results shown in tables and maps.
thanks.feature3: Feature 3: Tones (view tone values and tone classes). The site organizes tone values and tone classes for the selected regions and locations, with different tone classes shown in different colors.
thanks.feature4: Feature 4: Characters (view readings and Middle Chinese categories). Enter Chinese characters to view their phonetic values, annotations, and Middle Chinese categories across locations.
thanks.feature5: Feature 5: Regional Mapping (draw dialect maps using atlas classifications or pronunciation-dictionary regions).
thanks.feature6: Feature 6: Custom Mapping (add your own data to create maps). Users can select and annotate points on the map, and the site automatically assigns colors based on feature values.
thanks.feature7: Blue text in tables, such as phonological categories and phonetic values, is generally clickable. Clicking it opens a detailed query in a new pop-up, making it easy to compare the new results with the original ones.
thanks.feature8: Points on the map are also clickable and open detailed information.
thanks.welcomeText: Welcome to "Dialect Pronunciation Atlas"—explore the historical layers of dialects with us!
thanks.devPara1: At first, I only wanted to build a tool that suited my own research. Before I knew it, I had begun exploring a vast starry sky. From the first line of code to the first working feature, from a tentative idea to a steadily growing system, days and nights passed at the keyboard as the vision gradually took root. Watching the site grow felt like watching my own child learn to walk, slowly taking on a shape of its own. Every button and every interaction carries the imprint of a moment in time. I was exhausted by the challenge of implementing the query logic I imagined, yet overjoyed whenever a visual idea finally came to life. All these fragments became the project's flesh and blood, its spirit and soul.
thanks.devPara2: It was also a journey of personal transformation. I went from knowing nothing about front-end development to exploring the DOM, experimenting with virtual scrolling, learning frameworks, and eventually appreciating the elegance of JWT and ORM. I learned by building and matured through mistakes. Most fascinating of all, the very bricks with which I built the site were the knowledge I longed to acquire: developing the site deepened my understanding of phonology, while studying phonology drove each new iteration of the code. Technology was no longer a set of cold instructions, but a vessel for carrying culture; culture was no longer confined to distant texts, but gradually became something interactive, traceable, and tangible.
thanks.devPara3: This is the answer I wrote with code and passion: the most sincere gift an ordinary student could offer to the field of dialect studies. Thank you to everyone who encounters it. I hope this still-imperfect creation can stir a small ripple of curiosity in your heart, or save you a little time spent searching through sources. That alone would give its existence meaning.
thanks.devPara4:
May the voices of every region live on;
May the beauty of Chinese characters always be cherished;
May the flame of civilization endure through every interaction and every moment of resonance.
